evidence: Earlier results on Pfaffian rank degrees and ladder Pfaffian Euler characteristics have distinct invariants and no stated matching-hole Jacobian decomposition.

The matching-zero determinant theorem treats nonsymmetric full matrices, not a Pfaffian linear section in an alternating matrix space; the determinant is the square of the Pfaffian on skew matrices and its derivative vanishes on the Pfaffian locus, so its singular-stratification assertion does not imply the present one.
The hollow symmetric determinant has a different conormal variety and is not an implication of this claim or vice versa.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Neither generic Pfaffian codimension-six rank singularities, nor prior determinant/symmetric-space classifications, imply the added k linear singular components and two generic transverse quadratic types. The paper’s matching-edge kernel dichotomy is a genuinely separate statement.
